notes.title: PATCH (0.2.7)
notes.notes:
Enemy AI improved. They follow the player in a more consistent manner. This should solve some frustration with their unexpected behavior.

More visual clarity with holes where you can roll through.

Clearer hints for first-time players.

notes.title: Apr 23 2025 - PATCH (v0.2.6)
notes.notes:
This is a bug that's been present since the early prototype and I'm happy to announce it's been fixed! Trying to interact key with objects, environments and NPCs used to be unpredictable. Leading to frustration during very tense gameplay moments (Especially the final boss).

notes.title: Apr 16 2025 - PATCH (v0.2.5)
notes.notes:
Small Patch to Fix a Couple of Bugs:


Illapa now crushes you: In the last update, Illapa wouldn’t kill you if it stepped on you. This bug has been fixed.
Fixed gamepad navigation in the pause menu.
Tutorial dialog now detects whether you’re using a controller to explain the correct buttons/controls.


Coming Soon:

Adjust interaction range with entities to improve lever and interactable usability.
